findings.cause: Error-state label TEXT uses TRUNCATE and FIXED height 20/22 instead of following Compact line-height 18/20.
Unbound fixed root height prevents content-driven shrink.
General spacing padding plus bare text line height; no shared control/row height equation.
Header content/font and spacing geometry differs from body cell.
